description: Land Acquisition - Chemmalai, Maritimepattu D/S Division, Mullaitivu District - Amended Gaz. Ex. No. 2219/32 on 16.03.2021 Ingiriya D/S Division - Amended Gaz. Ex. No. 2309/07 on 06.12.2023, Mulatiyana D/S Division, Matara District - Amended Gaz. No. 2271/59 on 18.03.2022, Kundasale D/S Division - Amended Pelenwatta, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land acquisitions with descriptions of properties, owners, locations, extents, and boundaries. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, including amendments to previous land acquisition notices, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
